statement: Every event emission the unwired-event census (scripts/census/unwired-event-census.mjs) classifies as ORPHANED (no listener anywhere: 46 at authoring) or TEST-ONLY (118 at authoring, of 189 distinct emitted events) is explicitly adjudicated in a checked-in ledger (scripts/census/unwired-event-adjudications.json) with one of three verdicts and evidence: WIRED (a consumer was built — the mechanism was designed for a purpose, finish it: the readModelDivergence class, whose missing consumer let run-15's cache staleness freeze the cluster), DELETED (dead code removed per remove-dead-code-on-contact), or INTENTIONAL-DIAGNOSTIC (fire-and-forget by design, with the reason recorded); and a re-runnable checker fails when the census finds an emission with no ledger entry, so new unwired events cannot accumulate silently. Adjudication priority: control-plane failure events first (HEARTBEAT_FAILED, LEASE_EXPIRED, REPLICA_STATE_MACHINE PERSISTENCE_ERROR, SPLIT_FAILED/MERGE_FAILED, RECONCILER CYCLE_ERROR).

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.

The census MUST classify src-wired / test-only / orphaned (a count-only census false-negatives the readModelDivergence class, which had test listeners); adjudication verdicts require evidence (file:line of the new consumer, the deletion commit, or the diagnostic rationale).

No bulk INTENTIONAL-DIAGNOSTIC verdicts: each control-plane failure-event adjudication is individual; batching is allowed only for homogeneous diagnostic families explicitly listed together with one shared rationale.
